index.title: Cancel debts with friends
index.intro: A debt is a record between you and a friend, confirmed on both phones.
index.what: Cancelling removes debts that go in a circle: nobody's balance changes.

privacy.group: Everyone in the session sees who is in it. The phone that runs the session sees who owes whom.
privacy.relay: The phone that passes a payment on sees which reserve it is paid from.
privacy.fee: Paying the recording fee, or recording it yourself, shows publicly that your wallet took part in cancelling debts.
privacy.hidden: Who owes whom is never made public. The phone that runs the session sees the debts among the people in it.
privacy.chain: Publicly, only how many people took part and the total cancelled are shown.

host.title: Start a session
host.askToScan: Ask your friends to scan this code.
host.collecting: Collecting debts from the people here…

failures.RadioOff: Turn on Bluetooth and Wi-Fi so friends can find this phone.
failures.Permission: Allow nearby devices in Settings so friends can find this phone.
failures.Unsupported: This phone can't start a session.
failures.Busy: The connection is busy with another session. Close it and try again.
failures.Timeout: Nobody connected in time. Stay close and try again.
failures.Rejected: A friend couldn't connect. Stay close and try again.
failures.Error: The connection failed. Move closer and try again.

join.title: Join a session
join.scanHint: Scan the code on your friend's phone.
join.notFound: Couldn't find your friend's phone. Stay close and try again.

lobby.headline: Ask your friends to scan this code.

collecting.headline: Collecting debts from the people here…

waiting.headline: Confirmed
waiting.body: You confirmed. Waiting for the others. If the result isn't recorded by {{expires}}, your debts stay as they were.

agreed.headline: Agreed
agreed.body: Agreed. It's done once recorded (before {{expires}}). If it isn't recorded by {{expires}}, your payments still count and the circle's debts come back.

recorded.headline: Recorded
recorded.body: Recorded publicly. The cancelled debts are applied.

void.headline: Not recorded in time
void.body: It wasn't recorded in time. Your debts stay as they were, and any payments you made still count.

undecided.headline: We can't tell yet
undecided.body: We can no longer tell whether this was recorded. Your debts stay as they were until we can; other changes still work.

abandoned.headline: Session ended
abandoned.body: The session ended before you confirmed. Nothing changed.

nothing.headline: Nothing to cancel
nothing.body: There was nothing to cancel among these debts.

proof.missing: The proof isn't ready. The phone that started the session keeps trying; recording needs it.
proof.invalid: The proof that came with the result didn't check out. The result is still agreed; recording it publicly may not be possible.
proof.absent: The result came without a proof. It is still agreed; recording it publicly may not be possible.

remainder.title: What is left to pay
remainder.intro: Paying the rest is a normal Buckspay payment. The debt goes down for good once the payment is credited.
remainder.failed: This payment failed. The debt is back to {{amount}}.
remainder.claimNote: Reporting the loss destroys the other person's security deposit. It does not pay you.
remainder.undecided: We can't tell yet whether this payment was credited. It doesn't count yet.
remainder.unknown: We couldn't follow this payment. It doesn't count yet.
remainder.settleBy: Use this payment, or let it be credited, before {{date}} for the debt to go down.
remainder.togetherNote: Crediting together shows publicly that these payments were made together.
remainder.simplify: Replace {{path}} with one payment {{from}} → {{to}}? Everyone on the path has to agree.
